name: Tooyama Masae
source:
Yukari's mother. Given that, she should be quite old, but she doesn't look it at all.

She taught Yukari various techniques. It's hard to tell if she's serious or just spaced out.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/okusama/chara.html]official site[/url]]
